Charles Lyell argued that the Earth must be extremely old based on the fact that:

options.A: many processes that can be observed act extremely slowly.
options.B: uniformitarianism can account for significant geological features.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - All of the above.

questions.stem_text: Pizarro was able to subdue the entire Inca empire largely because:

options.A: his horses and guns frightened the Incas into submission.
options.B: he was such a brilliant military strategist.
options.C: the empire had never won the allegiance of the peoples it had conquered.
options.D: he arrived with a superior force of more than 80,000 soldiers.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - the empire had never won the allegiance of the peoples it had conquered.

Which of the following is evidence of new uses for plants during the Middle Stone Age?

options.A: the use of seeds as a natural insecticide in Altamira cave in southwestern Europe
options.B: plant materials such as flowers in Aurignacian burials in southern France
options.C: plant material lining the floor of Sibudu Cave in South Africa
options.D: the use of wood in the Gravettian tradition to make spear-throwers and canoes

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - plant material lining the floor of Sibudu Cave in South Africa
